transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
Honestly, I've just completely lost interest in everything I used to enjoy, and it's been like this for about three months now. I just feel so unmotivated to do anything at all.
Have you been feeling depressed or down most days as well, and has this been going on for longer than two years?
Yes, I've definitely been feeling really down and depressed lately. But it hasn't been going on for two years—this all started about three months ago.
Did these symptoms begin after a specific stressful life event or major change, such as a loss, breakup, job problem, or other significant stressor?
No, not really. I can't recall any specific stressful event or major change that started all of this. It just seemed to happen out of nowhere.
Have you also had changes in sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, or feelings of guilt or worthlessness?
No, I haven't really noticed any changes in my sleep or appetite. My energy and concentration seem okay, and I don't really have any feelings of guilt or worthlessness either.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't had any thoughts like that at all. I've never felt like hurting myself, and I don't think that life isn't worth living.
How much are these symptoms affecting your daily life, work, school, or relationships?

They're having a huge impact, honestly. I have zero motivation to complete any of my tasks at work, and I've completely stopped putting effort into seeing my friends or socializing. I just don't care about my hobbies or achieving anything anymore; it all feels pointless.
Have you been feeling depressed or down most days as well, and has this been going on for longer than two years?

Yes, I have been feeling down and depressed most of the time lately. However, it hasn't been going on for two years. These feelings and my complete lack of interest and motivation only started about three months ago.
Have you also had changes in sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, or feelings of guilt or worthlessness?
Like I mentioned earlier, I haven't really noticed any changes in my sleep or appetite. My concentration seems fine, and I don't have any feelings of guilt or worthlessness.
Have you also had changes in sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, or feelings of guilt or worthlessness?
No, I really haven't noticed any changes in my sleep, appetite, energy, or concentration. I also don't feel particularly guilty or worthless. Everything is pretty much normal in those areas.
